# Select

Dropdown for 5+ mutually exclusive options (institution type, role, time zone).

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Select` · Forms

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Select options={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Select" options="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Native select dressed like Input, same label/hint/error/focus treatment.
